name: Tank Top Master

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Direct DMG 60% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants [Immune to Death] to the target's column. Direct DMG 22% of Max HP to the target's column.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants [Immune to Death] to the target's column. Direct DMG 22% > 28% of Max HP to the target's column.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: +20% HP to self. At own turn start, Dispel all enemies. On entry, heals self based on Max HP. If it took damage or lost HP, at own turn end and on death deals Extra DMG 51% ATK (scaling with damage/HP lost) to 4 random enemies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Reflect Extra DMG now hits 4 random > all enemies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Reflect Extra DMG 51% > 61% ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons Tank-Top Tiger (ATK by 30% of TTM's HP). After an ally acts, Tank-Top Tiger will deal damage to 1 random enemy by 100% ATK. Prioritises enemies in [Specialized Unyielding] and trigger [Breakthrough] (cancels specialized and normal unyielding state). Restores Tank-Top Master's [Specialized Protection] by 20% Max HP

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc:
Summons Tank-Top Blackhole
Tank-Top brothers can still [Follow-up] if TTM is [Stuck] Tank-Top brothers never fall even if TTM is dead Only 1 DMG reflect will be triggered Can reflect DMG received in [Specialized Protection] Removal of [DMG Sharing] applies to all support characters Tank-Top brothers have no follow-up limit Cannot reflect if TTM is [Exited] TTM can restore [Specialized Protection] faster with SSR+ DSK

effects.desc: Control status prevents the target from casting [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], usually for 2 turns.
Unfavorable effects negate the target's invincibility/anti-death effects, allowing it to be knocked down as normal.

bondList: Tank-Top Master + Tank-Top Tiger + Tank-Top Black Hole
